purpose: Classify and recover from fleet setup/readiness failures without mislabeling stale paths, shell mistakes, optional Hermes problems, blocked CMD shims, provider failures, tmux state, or target-repository gates.

steps.name: preserve evidence
steps.action: Capture exact command, shell, current directory, exit code, setup-summary/setup-transcript or startup-readiness artifact, installed state observations, and any blocked compatibility-shim signal before retrying.

classes.repository-path-invalid: selected directory is missing or is not the expected repository root; repair path discovery before Git/setup
classes.shell-command-mismatch: command belongs to a different shell, such as PowerShell irm used in cmd.exe; repair delivery syntax before diagnosing product/provider state
classes.cmd-shim-blocked: state.json and Start-AgentSwitchboard.ps1 are healthy but agent-switchboard.cmd is missing or Windows denies shim execution, including Access is denied / exit 5; use the PowerShell readiness workflow
classes.hermes-deferred: Hermes unavailable, skipped, blocked, or hanging while core setup is the priority; use -SkipHermesInstall, record Hermes=TBD, continue core proof
classes.partial-install: exactly one of state or installed PowerShell readiness launcher exists; repair/reuse setup required
classes.adapter-blocked: fleet installed but requested non-optional adapter unavailable
classes.provider-verification: adapter available but authentication/model/quota/hosted response remains launch-time proof
classes.target-repo-dirty: target repository does not satisfy GNHF launch contract
classes.sprint-runtime: fleet and target gates passed; failure occurred after sprint launch

steps.name: repair owning boundary only
steps.action: Repair repository discovery for path failures; repair shell delivery for parser failures; route a blocked CMD shim to installed Start-AgentSwitchboard.ps1 through pwsh; defer Hermes through the repository-owned skip flag; use setup/readiness surfaces for core bootstrap problems; provider flow for provider problems; target-repo isolation for dirty work.

steps.name: avoid proof inflation
steps.action: Do not call a stale path an installer failure, a CMD parser error a Hermes failure, a blocked CMD compatibility shim a fleet failure, a missing PowerShell readiness launcher an agent failure, tmux attachment fleet installation proof, or adapter readiness hosted-response proof.

steps.name: rerun exact failed gate
steps.action: After repair, rerun only from a known safe state and preserve the first failed artifact as a separate attempt. For cmd-shim-blocked, do not retry the blocked shim; execute the canonical PowerShell readiness path instead. Do not retry Hermes in the core-autoconfig lane after it has been deferred.

steps.name: handoff
steps.action: Report boundary, shell, resolved repo root, PowerShell readiness launcher state, optional CMD shim state, evidence path, Hermes deferred/TBD state when applicable, repaired state, remaining unproved gate, and one exact next command.

proofCeiling: Failure classification and recovery routing only; success requires observed artifacts from the repaired owning boundary.
